summary: Repaired the administrator advertising calendar boundary. Verified administrators with the ads view permission can list bounded scheduled, active, and ended calendar projections, while verified administrators with the ads scheduling permission can schedule a waiting-payment request through a strict optimistic-version boundary. Persistent scheduling now validates request state, interval expiry, same-placement overlap, and atomically persists the Cairo projection and request history.

scopeNotes: This is an authorized Backend truth repair directly required by the administrator advertising screens in frontend_070; it adds the missing HTTP and persistent boundary without starting a frontend task.
The schedule request intentionally accepts only expectedVersion; the server derives the scheduled state from the route semantics.
Calendar and scheduling responses are explicit safe projections and do not expose payment-proof storage keys, private documents, internal notes, or bank-verification claims.
knownGaps: Live MongoDB persistence verification was not run because no isolated non-production replica-set test topology was configured; deterministic repository/service and HTTP tests cover the boundary locally.
Banner publication and financial-review HTTP projections remain separate later B7 boundaries and are not part of this repair.
